source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Design phase (PDF 8).

blocks.text: Design phase mein hum plan karte hain ke software kaisa dikhega aur kaise kaam karega. Yeh ghar banane se pehle us ka naqsha (blueprint) banane jaisa hai. Is phase mein hum:

items: Diagrams banate hain: yeh dikhane ke liye ke software ke mukhtalif hisse kaise jurenge aur mil kar kaam karenge. Misal: hum flowchart banate hain jo dikhata hai ke program kaam poora karne ke liye kaun se steps lega.

Models banate hain: software ki banawat (structure) dikhane ke liye. Is mein user interface ke mockups (namoone) bhi ho sakte hain jo dikhate hain ke program kaisa nazar aayega aur users us ke saath kaise kaam karenge.

Architecture plan karte hain: software ki poori banawat tay karna, aur yeh ke mukhtalif components (hisse) aapas mein kaise kaam karenge. Is se program munazzam (organized) rehta hai aur aasani se chalta hai.
Requirements wazeh karte hain: saaf likhna ke software ke har hisse ko kya karna hai, ta ke har feature plan ho aur koi cheez reh na jaye.

blocks.text: Yeh steps yaqeeni banate hain ke aakhri software munazzam ho, user-friendly (istemal mein aasan) ho aur users ki zarooratein poori kare.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Is phase ko naya ghar design karne jaisa samjhein. Banana shuru karne se pehle naqshe (blueprints) chahiye jo dikhayein ke kamre aur furniture kahan honge.

blocks.prompt: Long Question 1 kehta hai: software application mein user registration ke process ka flowchart banayein. Is ke aham steps likhein.
blocks.explanation: Start; user sign-up form kholta hai aur naam, email aur password likhta hai; system check karta hai (kya email theek hai aur pehle se istemal nahi hua? kya password mazboot hai?); agar nahi to error dikha kar wapas form par; agar haan to account save hota hai aur confirmation message bheja jata hai; End. Flowchart mein Start aur End oval (gol) shakal mein, kaam rectangle mein, check (decision) diamond mein, aur teer (arrows) tarteeb dikhate hain.

answer_figure.alt: Flowchart: Start (oval) se 'Open sign-up form', phir 'Enter name, email and password' (input ki tirchhi shakal), phir diamond 'Details valid?'. No: 'Show error message' aur wapas input par. Yes: 'Save the new account', 'Send confirmation message', aur End (oval).
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram (pehle khud banayein, phir milayein): user registration ka flowchart
answer_figure.long_description: Upar Start ka oval. Teer neeche 'Open sign-up form' ke rectangle tak, phir parallelogram 'Enter name, email and password' (input). Phir hare diamond mein sawal 'Details valid?' (email pehle istemal na hua ho, password mazboot ho). Daen taraf 'No' ka teer 'Show error message' ke dabbe tak jata hai, jahan se lakeer oopar ho kar input wale parallelogram mein wapas aati hai. Neeche 'Yes' ka teer 'Save the new account', phir 'Send confirmation message', aur aakhir mein End ka oval.

items: Design: software kaisa dikhega aur kaise kaam karega, is ka plan (ghar ke naqshe ki tarah).
Steps: diagrams (flowchart), models (UI mockups), architecture plan, requirements wazeh karna.
